text: I can choose between server-side sessions and self-contained tokens for a given design and defend the choice in terms of revocation, latency and dependencies.
I can draw the authorization code + PKCE flow step by step and explain what the code_verifier and state parameters each defend against.
I can explain the difference between an ID token and an access token and list the ID token claims a client must validate.
I can decode a JWT by hand, estimate its size, and list the RFC 8725 verification checks including pinned algorithms and kid lookup in a JWKS.
I can compute the exposure window of a stolen token and compare short TTL + refresh rotation, a denylist and introspection as fixes.
